proposed.sourceName: Halal Monitoring Committee (HMC) — Criteria for Halal
proposed.paraphrase: HMC's halal criteria require a swift hand-slaughter that renders the animal insensible to pain, with the Tasmiyah recited by a Muslim slaughterman on each animal; animals not slaughtered by these Islamic rites do not qualify as halal, so gelatin derived from non-zabiha animals is impermissible under HMC's standard.

proposed.sourceName: Heliyon — Towards halal pharmaceutical: Exploring alternatives to animal-based ingredients (Herdiana et al.)
proposed.paraphrase: Peer-reviewed review stating gelatin is collagen-derived from pig and bovine skin/bone and that halal certification is essential for gelatin from non-halal animals — gelatin from animals not slaughtered according to Islamic law is not permissible absent halal certification.
